incidents.name: LinkDao pool swap callback without repayment check
incidents.notes: The LinkDao pool's swap() hands control to the caller's callback and then never verifies that the borrowed amount was repaid, so the attacker took 29,663 USDT out while returning 1 USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x6524a5fd3fec179db3b3c1d21f700da7abe6b0de created 2023-11-15T22:53:58Z by 0x7ab8b73fcd3abb89f99d96694fa7701d2a83ce34, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xdf6b0200b4e1bc4a310f33df95a9087cc2c79038; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
